summary: The Satan Killer is a 1993 American thriller-horror film directed by Stephen Calamari and starring Stephen Sayre. The note describes it as a crime-horror film shot in Virginia Beach, Virginia. It was widely distributed through A.I.P Home Video and is noted as a cult favorite.
one_line: The Satan Killer is a 1993 American thriller-horror film directed by Stephen Calamari, filmed in Virginia Beach.
